Architect of Record bears separate strict liability for design defects." placementIntent="legal-framework" suggestedSearchQuery="Article 1723 solidary liability architect contractor diagram" replacementNotes="Create a split diagram. Left column: Design Defect — AoR is strictly liable (no contractor involvement). Right column: Construction Defect — AiCC and Contractor are solidarily liable (joint and several). Add annotation: 'Cannot modify by contract.'" suggestedAsset="Diagram or reference image" alt="Timeline: 15-year liability and 10-year prescription under Article 1723" caption="Future diagram: timeline: 15-year liability and 10-year prescription under article 1723" />
